method: Expectations come from calls.c and, for which calls are jumps, from the system disassembler (otool -tV), not from any engine under test. At -O0 every call is a call instruction. At -O2 main ends in a jump to dispatch and dispatch is a single jump to run_command: two tail calls on the way from main to system.

imports.presentByInputWhy: checked with nm -u: without optimization clang calls the fortified ___snprintf_chk, with -O2 plain _snprintf; names are compared without leading underscores

paths.why: main calls parse, parse calls validate; ordinary calls at both levels
main returns dispatch(), dispatch returns run_command(), run_command calls system; at -O2 the first two are jumps
puts is used only by unused_helper, which nothing calls
parse reaches validate, strlen and atoi only

callers.why: kept by the used attribute, called by nobody

reached only through a pointer table that main reads; no call instruction names it. An engine that follows the pointer and reports main is right; one that reports nobody is also right, as long as it does not conclude the function is dead
